title: Umami Springy French Suet Clafoutis
description: A savory French clafoutis featuring suet and spring vegetables, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly and packed with umami flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Knead the chopped suet and flour together in a large bowl until well combined.
Add the sliced leeks, mushrooms, and asparagus to the bowl and mix until the vegetables are evenly distributed.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, shredded gruyere cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a thick batter forms.
Pour the batter into a 9x13 inch baking dish and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake the clafoutis for 35-40 minutes, or until puffed and golden brown.
Remove the clafoutis from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the clafoutis warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
